entities.name: DUSP6
observations: DUSP6 protein was measured by pretreatment immunohistochemistry in AEH/progestin-response studies.
Higher or strong pretreatment DUSP6 was associated with progestin sensitivity; weak expression was associated with non-regression.

entities.name: Atypical endometrial hyperplasia
observations: Atypical endometrial hyperplasia is the disease context in which DUSP6 was evaluated as a predictor of progestin response.
The available studies use AEH terminology; direct formally designated EIN-specific evidence was not identified.

entities.name: Progestin therapy
observations: Progestin therapy was effective in 89% of AEH in the 2015 study; the specific agent was not identified in the abstract.
The 2022 study used hysteroscopic resection plus a levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine device.

entities.name: PMID:25451692
observations: In AEH treated with progestin, pretreatment DUSP6 was higher in sensitive than resistant cases; DUSP6 increased after treatment in sensitive but not resistant groups.
The study supports predictive value but the abstract does not report cohort size, agent, or quantitative effect estimate.

entities.name: PMID:34837386
observations: In 36 women under 45 with AEH or early endometrial cancer treated with hysteroscopic resection plus LNG-IUD, weak pretreatment DUSP6 was associated with resistance/no regression (RR 16, P=0.0074).
Reported prediction metrics were sensitivity 80%, specificity 90%, PPV 57.1%, NPV 96.4%, and AUC 0.85.
DUSP6 was not associated with recurrence after initial regression (RR 0.4, P=0.53).
